data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: bridge-fsck count extraction strategy — bridge-fsck (ticket-bridge-fsck.py) CLI does NOT have --count-only mode currently. Two paths: (a) PREFERRED: invoke bridge_fsck.enumerate_orphan_anomalies Python API via subprocess (python3 -c 'from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.bridge_fsck import enumerate_orphan_anomalies; import json; print(json.dumps(enumerate_orphan_anomalies(...)))') and parse structured JSON output — this avoids fragile report parsing. (b) FALLBACK: if API import fails, parse the human-readable 'label_only_orphan' section of the report via well-anchored regex. AC verifies path (a) works; path (b) is fallback only. Add prerequisite check: bridge_fsck.enumerate_orphan_anomalies importable; fail with exit 7 (new code) if not.
